 "content": "from collections import Counter


def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    counts = Counter(v for row in grid for v in row)
    background = counts.most_common(1)[0][0]
    line_color = next(color for color, _ in counts.most_common() if color != background)

    # Grid lines are the rows and columns dominated by the separator color.
    row_lines = [r for r in range(h) if sum(v == line_color for v in grid[r]) > w / 2]
    col_lines = [c for c in range(w) if sum(grid[r][c] == line_color for r in range(h)) > h / 2]

    # Colored intersections delimit the portion of the lattice represented in the output.
    marked = [(ri, ci) for ri, r in enumerate(row_lines)
              for ci, c in enumerate(col_lines)
              if grid[r][c] not in (background, line_color)]
    if not marked:
        return [[background]]
    r0, r1 = min(r for r, _ in marked), max(r for r, _ in marked)
    c0, c1 = min(c for _, c in marked), max(c for _, c in marked)

    out = []
    for ri in range(r0, r1):
        row = []
        for ci in range(c0, c1):
            corners = [grid[row_lines[ri]][col_lines[ci]],
                       grid[row_lines[ri]][col_lines[ci + 1]],
                       grid[row_lines[ri + 1]][col_lines[ci]],
                       grid[row_lines[ri + 1]][col_lines[ci + 1]]]
            color = corners[0]
            row.append(color if color not in (background, line_color) and all(x == color for x in corners) else background)
        out.append(row)
    return out
"
}

def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    counts = Counter(v for row in grid for v in row)
    background = counts.most_common(1)[0][0]
    line_color = max((v for v in counts if v != background), key=counts.get)
    row_lines = [r for r in range(h) if sum(v == line_color for v in grid[r]) > w / 2]
    col_lines = [c for c in range(w) if sum(grid[r][c] == line_color for r in range(h)) > h / 2]
    marks = [(ri, ci) for ri, r in enumerate(row_lines) for ci, c in enumerate(col_lines)
             if grid[r][c] not in (background, line_color)]
    if not marks:
        return [[background]]
    r0, r1 = min(r for r, _ in marks), max(r for r, _ in marks)
    c0, c1 = min(c for _, c in marks), max(c for _, c in marks)
    out = []
    for ri in range(r0, r1):
